verdict.rationale: ADK documents a unit-testing-style workflow: per-session test files described as "a form of unit testing", expected tool-call trajectories, and an `adk eval` CLI. Its code-first design and swappable model adapters suggest testability. However, nothing in the evidence shows mocked or stubbed models or tools; the documented tests are evals of real agent-model interactions. missing for 10: documented mock/fake model support, tool mocking or stubbing utilities, integration with standard test runners like pytest, independent hands-on corroboration.
